name: Candidate Interview
description: Organize interview evidence without making an automated hiring decision.

sections.title: Questions and Evidence
sections.instruction: Summarize each substantive question and the candidate's evidence-based response.
sections.item_format:
| Topic or Question | Evidence from Response |
| --- | --- |

sections.title: Examples and Follow-up Probes
sections.instruction: List concrete examples, results, and follow-up probes discussed.

sections.title: Role-Criteria Evidence
sections.instruction: Map only observed evidence to role criteria mentioned by interviewers. Do not score or infer protected traits.

sections.title: Candidate Questions
sections.instruction: List questions asked by the candidate and answers provided.

sections.title: Missing Evidence
sections.instruction: List areas not covered or requiring a follow-up conversation.

sections.title: Logistics and Follow-ups
sections.instruction: Capture availability, stated constraints, process steps, and owners.
